cross_source.title: FiveM neste PC, ao lado dos registros do Windows de programas executados
cross_source.absent: FiveM.exe is not in FiveM's program folders.
cross_source.folders_written: FiveM's own folders were last written {{date}} ({{days}} before this scan).

cross_source.selected: {{count}} entries for those names; the latest is from {{date}}.
cross_source.no_entry_named: no entry for FiveM.exe, GTA5.exe, GTA5_Enhanced.exe, PlayGTAV.exe or FiveM_b…_GTAProcess.exe. It holds {{count}} entries; the oldest is from {{date}} ({{days}} before this scan).
cross_source.no_entry: no entry for those names. It holds {{count}} entries; the oldest is from {{date}} ({{days}} before this scan).
cross_source.could_not_show: it holds nothing as old as FiveM's last write, so it could not show it.
cross_source.not_read_admin: not read without administrator rights. Whether it holds an entry is not known.
cross_source.not_read: not read — {{reason}}. Whether it holds an entry is not known.
cross_source.switched_off: Prefetch is switched off on this PC; it keeps no such record.
cross_source.causes_intro: Isto não é evidência de nada. O mesmo resultado vem de:

causes.reinstall: Windows installed again, reset, or a new PC, with FiveM's folders copied or synced from before
causes.cleanup: Windows' own clean-up (Disk Cleanup, Storage Sense), or a clean-up program of any kind
causes.prefetch_off: Prefetch switched off, as some older SSD and performance guides advise
causes.fivem_reinstalled: FiveM reinstalled, or its folders moved from another drive or PC
causes.other_name: FiveM started under a name these records do not list, or in a way Windows does not record here
causes.windows_removes: Windows removing its own records: Prefetch files are replaced, BAM entries expire, PCA records only launches from File Explorer
causes.clock: a clock that was changed, so that times from different sources are not on the same clock

session.title: FiveM for GTA V {{edition}}: its last session, beside its own folders

start.switched_off: Prefetch is switched off on this PC, so when this run began is not recorded
start.not_read: when this run began is not known: Prefetch was not read ({{reason}})
start.not_recorded: Prefetch holds no run of this edition, so when this run began is not recorded

end.not_recorded: the end of this run is not recorded
end.not_read: when it ended is not known: BAM was not read ({{reason}})

created.after_start: last created {{duration}} after the session began
created.before_start: last created {{duration}} before the session began

written.after_start: last written {{duration}} after the session began
written.before_start: last written {{duration}} before the session began

latest_log_write.after_start: the folder's latest log write was {{duration}} after the session began
latest_log_write.before_start: the folder's latest log write was {{duration}} before the session began
latest_log_write.before_end: the folder's latest log write was {{duration}} before the session ended
latest_log_write.near_end: the folder's latest log write was within 10 minutes of the session's end
latest_log_write.after_end: the folder's latest log write was {{duration}} after the session ended

session.not_listed: not read: the folder could not be listed

session.causes_intro: Isto não é evidência de nada. O mesmo resultado vem de:

causes.standing_still: a player standing still, or playing on with nothing new to write: FiveM writes its folders when something happens, not on a clock
causes.ended_abruptly: FiveM ended by Task Manager, a crash or a shutdown, which may skip the write it makes when it closes
causes.removes_logs: FiveM removing its own older logs, or its own "clear cache"
causes.other_folder: FiveM installed in, or moved to, a folder other than the one this program reads, or reinstalled
causes.other_account: FiveM started by another Windows account on this PC: its folders are that account's
causes.opened_closed: FiveM opened and closed before the game started, or updating itself
causes.launchers: GTA V installed through Steam, Epic or the Rockstar launcher, which start the game in different ways
causes.prefetch_off: Prefetch switched off, as some older SSD and performance guides advise
causes.clock: a clock that was changed, so that times from different sources are not on the same clock
causes.cleanup: disk-cleaning software, or a profile moved or restored from a backup

conclusion.no_suspicious_evidence: Sem evidências suspeitas nas fontes examinadas
conclusion.high_confidence: Evidência de alta confiança que exige análise do checker

conclusion_note.no_suspicious_evidence: Nenhum indicador definido foi encontrado nas fontes que puderam ser lidas. Isto NÃO é uma declaração de que o PC está limpo: um software não vê outro PC, hardware DMA, firmware comprometido nem um Windows reinstalado.
conclusion_note.inconclusive: Fontes demais não puderam ser examinadas (por exemplo, sem direitos de administrador) para que a ausência de alertas signifique algo.
conclusion_note.manual_review: Uma única fonte mostra algo que merece análise humana. Leia as explicações legítimas listadas antes de concluir qualquer coisa.
conclusion_note.corroborated: Indicadores vieram de duas ou mais fontes independentes. Cada um ainda tem explicações legítimas a considerar.
conclusion_note.high_confidence: Um indicador específico (FLAG) foi corroborado por outra fonte independente. Isto exige análise do checker; não é uma condenação automática.

assessment.sources: Fontes independentes com alerta: {{sources}} · com FLAG: {{flags}}
assessment.supporting: Em que a conclusão se apoia
assessment.proximity: Proximidade temporal de {{minutes}} min entre "{{a}}" e "{{b}}". Proximidade não é causalidade.

caveat.software_only: Uma verificação por software dentro do Windows não vê cheats em outro PC, dispositivos DMA que imitam hardware comum, firmware comprometido ou vestígios apagados por reinstalação do Windows.
caveat.not_elevated: A verificação rodou sem direitos de administrador; várias fontes não puderam ser lidas.
caveat.standard_tier: Verificação padrão: as fontes avançadas (navegadores, arquivos do usuário, listas do Explorer, comandos do PowerShell) não foram lidas.
caveat.categories_not_checked: Algumas categorias não puderam ser verificadas nesta máquina.

tools.none: Nenhum nome do catálogo nas fontes lidas. Isto vale só para as fontes listadas abaixo.

status_note.suspected: Nome de executor ou injetor em contexto Roblox, sem nada mostrando execução.
